mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} AND create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN real_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} AND create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND create_time <= #{yesterdayEnd} THEN real_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdaySalesAmount FROM sale_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(real_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COUNT(1) AS orderCount FROM sale_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT sd.product_id AS productId, MAX(sd.product_name) AS productName, MAX(p.barcode) AS barcode, COALESCE(SUM(sd.quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(sd.amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM sale_detail sd INNER JOIN sale_order so ON so.id = sd.order_id LEFT JOIN product p ON sd.product_id = p.id WHERE so.is_deleted = 0 AND so.status = 1 AND so.create_time >= #{startTime} AND so.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY sd.product_id ORDER BY salesQuantity DESC, salesAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT payment_type AS paymentType, CASE payment_type WHEN 1 THEN '现金' WHEN 2 THEN '微信' WHEN 3 THEN '支付宝' ELSE '其他' END AS paymentTypeName, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(real_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sale_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS memberTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN register_time >= #{todayStart} AND register_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayNewMemberCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN register_time >= #{weekStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weekNewMemberCount, COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS totalBalance, COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS totalPoints, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN last_consume_time IS NOT NULL AND last_consume_time >= #{activeSince} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeMemberCount FROM member WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM member WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND register_time >= #{startTime} AND register_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS productTotal, COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS stockTotalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN low_stock_threshold IS NOT NULL AND stock <= low_stock_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lowStockProductCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN earliest_expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND earliest_expiration_date >= DATE(#{today}) AND earliest_expiration_date <= DATE(#{nearExpiryEnd}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nearExpiryProductCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN earliest_expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND earliest_expiration_date < DATE(#{today}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiredProductCount, COALESCE(SUM(stock * cost_price), 0) AS inventoryCostAmount FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT id AS productId, name AS productName, stock, low_stock_threshold AS lowStockThreshold, (low_stock_threshold - stock) AS gap FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND low_stock_threshold IS NOT NULL AND stock <= low_stock_threshold ORDER BY stock ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS productId, name AS productName, earliest_expiration_date AS earliestExpirationDate, DATEDIFF(earliest_expiration_date, DATE(#{today})) AS remainingDays, stock FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND earliest_expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND earliest_expiration_date >= DATE(#{today}) AND earliest_expiration_date <= DATE(#{nearExpiryEnd}) ORDER BY earliest_expiration_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
